scenes.en: Is your child squinting at the TV?
scenes.say: Is your child squinting at the TV? Watch for these three signs.

scenes.en: Sits very close to the TV or holds the phone near the face
scenes.say: One. Sitting very close to the TV, or holding the phone very near the face.

scenes.en: Squints or rubs the eyes often
scenes.say: Two. Squinting, or rubbing the eyes often.

scenes.en: Says the school board looks blurry
scenes.say: Three. Saying the school board looks blurry, or getting headaches after study.

scenes.en: Daily outdoor play and screen breaks help
scenes.say: Daily outdoor play and regular screen breaks are good habits for growing eyes.

scenes.en: Noticed a sign? Get your child's eyes tested.
scenes.say: Noticed any of these signs? Get your child's eyes tested by an eye specialist.
